title: Tears of Qingyao
next_chapter_hook: Just as Su Qingyao made her decision, an earth-shaking roar echoed from beyond the dimensional rift—Ling Yuan, the old sect master of Tianqing Sect, had led his forces to attack in person.

text.content:
The space within the dimensional rift shimmered with pale blue light, and the air was thick with the ancient气息 of long-forbidden formations. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his robes swaying gently without any wind. Deep within his eyes reflected countless swirling points of light—the threads of fate being analyzed by the Tianji Record.

"Three years ago, when you first questioned me, I knew you were the only person who could see through my disguise." Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet it carried with extraordinary clarity through this silent space. "So I've been waiting, waiting for the right moment to tell you something you must know."

He turned around, his gaze falling upon Su Qingyao's ice-cold face, and a bitter smile tugged at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao's gaze slightly narrowed, her voice carrying its usual cold detachment: "What exactly is this truth you speak of?"

Her hand remained on her sword hilt. Even in this strange space, facing this "waste" who had concealed himself for three years, she maintained the alertness to strike at any moment. Yet somehow, her heartbeat had unconsciously quickened by half a beat—an inexplicable premonition had seized her.

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't answer immediately. Instead, he raised his hand and waved it.

In the void of the dimensional rift, a massive screen of light slowly materialized. On it were densely packed names, arranged like stars, each accompanied by birth dates, bloodline markers, and fate annotations.

Su Qingyao's gaze was instinctively drawn to it, and the moment she saw a certain name, her pupils constricted sharply.

That was a name positioned at the very core of the screen—Su Qingyao, the marked time赫然显示：万年前。

dialogue.content:
"This is impossible!" Su Qingyao's voice trembled slightly. For the first time, that eternally cold visage showed a crack in its composure. "Ten thousand years ago... At that time, even Tianqing Sect didn't exist. How could I possibly—"

Her words cut off abruptly.

Because she saw the bloodline marker beside that name.

It was a dark cyan spiritual pattern, identical to the birthmark she had carried on her left wrist since childhood.

text.content:
Chen Ji's voice sounded at the appropriate moment, calm to the point of cruelty: "Ten thousand years ago, the Fate Writer was not a single person, but an entire bloodline family. Your Su family is the only descendant of this bloodline to survive until today."

He pointed to the name on the screen: "Su Qingyao, direct descendant of the Fate Writer family from ten thousand years ago, codename 'Cyan Phoenix,' was the only person at that time who possessed the complete Tianji Record's predictive abilities. Her sacrifice brought a hundred years of peace to humanity."

Chen Ji turned to face Su Qingyao, complex emotions swirling in his eyes: "And you are her reincarnation, as well as the inheritor of her bloodline."

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao's complexion had already turned pale. Her body swayed slightly, but she forced herself not to collapse.

"Reincarnation... inheritor..." She murmured these words repeatedly, her voice carrying a barely perceptible tremor. "So your approach to me all along wasn't coincidental?"

She lifted her head abruptly, her gaze piercing like a sword toward Chen Ji: "You approached me to exploit my bloodline!"

Chen Ji neither denied nor confirmed, simply watching her quietly.

text.content:
After a long while, Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice carrying a hint of imperceptible exhaustion: "Initially, that was indeed a factor."

He raised his head, his gaze fixed directly on Su Qingyao: "But did you really think I've spent these three years just to exploit you?"

Chen Ji suddenly laughed, the smile tinged with a hint of self-mockery: "Do you think I wanted to be defeated by you three times before the entire sect? Do you think I wanted you to see through my disguise again and again?"

His voice lowered: "Because I wanted you to choose yourself. Accept all of this, or—resist it."

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao stared at him blankly. For the first time, a hint of confusion appeared in those cold, clear eyes.

"Choice..." she whispered. "Do I even have the right to choose?"

Her voice was soft, yet it carried a bone-deep interrogation. She was the Inner Sect Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, the benchmark for the younger generation of the sect. Her pride would not allow her to become anyone's pawn—not even fate itself.

text.content:
Chen Ji took a step forward, closing the distance between them to less than three feet.

At this distance, Su Qingyao could clearly see what lay hidden in the depths of his eyes—not scheming, not exploitation, but a kind of weight she had never witnessed before.

"You do." Chen Ji's voice was soft but firm. "I can now seal your bloodline, so you'll never have to bear these burdens. But—"

He paused, a complex light flickering in his eyes: "But this means you'll lose an instinct: you will no longer be able to perceive the flow of fate. And I... may have to face the approaching final battle alone."

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao's eyelashes trembled slightly.

She suddenly understood the meaning behind Chen Ji's words—he wasn't threatening her, but exposing his own weaknesses to her.

"You tell me all this..." Su Qingyao's voice was hoarse. "Aren't you afraid I'll refuse and leave?"

Chen Ji turned around, his back to her, his voice carrying a hint of faint smile: "I am. But I'm more afraid of you living in ignorance, being pushed along by fate without knowing the truth."

text.content:
The air within the dimensional rift suddenly solidified for an instant.

Chen Ji slowly raised his right hand, and a ball of pale blue light materialized in his palm. That was the power of the Tianji Record Fragment—but this time, he didn't use it to predict the future, but to project the complete memory from ten thousand years ago.

On the screen, a woman bearing a seven-fold resemblance to Su Qingyao stood before countless armies. Her gaze was firm yet gentle, her lips curved with a resolute smile.

"Qingyao, remember—" the woman's voice echoed through time. "Fate is not meant to be submitted to, but to be written."

Then, she stepped into that forbidden land capable of destroying heaven and earth, never to return.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao's body shuddered violently.

That voice, that demeanor, that resolute back—she had never seen it before, yet felt impossibly familiar, as if memories carved into her bones were suddenly awakened.

Tears fell silently, dripping into the pale blue light, instantly dissolving into scattered stars.

"She... my past life..." Su Qingyao's voice choked. "Why did she do this?"

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't speak, simply standing quietly behind her.

After a long time, he finally spoke softly: "Because she believed some things are more important than her own life."

His voice paused: "And she passed this belief on to you."

The light within the dimensional rift gradually softened, and the ancient气息 in the air became warmer. Su Qingyao's tears continued to fall, but her gaze grew clear and resolute.

choice.prompt:
Su Qingyao took a deep breath and slowly wiped away the tears on her face. Her gaze fell upon Chen Ji, no longer carrying doubt or wariness, but instead an emotion she herself couldn't quite name.

"You said I can choose." Her voice regained its calm, yet carried an unprecedented seriousness. "Then, I choose—"

choices.description: Accept the memories from ten thousand years ago and the bloodline of the Fate Writer, bearing that heavy responsibility.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the ability to perceive fate, confronting the final battle alongside Chen Ji
choices.risk_hint: Bloodline awakening may bring unpredictable consequences

text.content:
Su Qingyao slowly closed her eyes and formed an ancient seal with both hands. A dark cyan light bloomed from her brow center, as if the bloodline dormant for ten thousand years had finally awakened.

In that moment, she felt it—countless images flooded into her consciousness like a tide. The battlefields of ten thousand years ago, the elegies of the Fate Writers, the shouts of countless heroic souls...

And amidst all these memory fragments, one figure always stood by her side, fighting shoulder to shoulder, never abandoning her.

text.content:
Su Qingyao's eyes snapped open, her gaze sharp as a sword.

"I don't need any bloodline inheritance!" Her voice was clear and resolute, "I am Su Qingyao, not some reincarnation from ten thousand years ago! My path, I walk it myself!"

She slapped her palm against her brow center, forcibly suppressing the awakening bloodline power. The dark cyan light trembled violently, yet gradually calmed under her will.

text.content:
Su Qingyao fell silent for a long while, then slowly raised her head.

"I will neither fully accept nor fully refuse." Her voice was calm yet resolute, "I want to dialogue with her, with myself from ten thousand years ago. If fate insists I bear something, then it shall be on my own terms, the way I choose to bear it."

She extended her right hand, gently touching that dark cyan light. In that instant, her silhouette overlapped with the woman from ten thousand years ago in the light curtain.

choices.memory_label: 青瑶选择了第三条路，命运出现新的变数

text.content:
After a moment, Su Qingyao slowly opened her eyes.

Her eyes held an indescribable radiance—something heavy,沉淀了万年; also something resolute, transcending those who came before.

"I have dialogued with her." Su Qingyao's voice was soft, yet carried a strange power, "She told me that fate has never been a fixed chess game, but a river that can be rewritten."

She turned to Chen Ji, her gaze complex yet gentle: "And you, are the one who wishes to rewrite fate, aren't you?"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji froze for a moment, then gently smiled.

That smile held none of his usual calculation or pretense—only a trace of peaceful relief: "You finally see clearly."

Su Qingyao stepped forward, standing shoulder to shoulder with him: "Since fate brought us together, since my bloodline can help you perceive more—I will walk this path with you."

Her voice was cold yet resolute: "But remember, Chen Ji. I am not your chess piece, I am your fellow traveler."

text.content:
Chen Ji gazed at her, a deep emotion flickering briefly in his eyes.

"Fellow traveler..." he softly repeated these three words, a genuine smile appearing at the corners of his mouth, "Very well, I will remember."

The light within the dimensional rift gradually faded; the sight of the two standing side by side grew increasingly distinct against the dissolving backdrop. In this moment, the gears of fate began to turn, a new chapter about to unfold.

However, just then—

An earth-shaking roar echoed from beyond the dimensional rift, and a powerful, familiar aura suddenly approached.

dialogue.content:
An aged yet majestic voice pierced through the dimensional rift's barrier, exploding beside their ears:

"Chen Ji! What are you doing!"

It was Ling Yuan's voice, filled with suppressed fury. Immediately after, the dimensional rift began to violently shudder, cracks spreading visibly at an alarming rate.

Su Qingyao's expression slightly changed: "The old Sect Master... how did he—"

Chen Ji's eyes grew cold: "It seems our time is running out."

text.content:
The dimensional rift began to collapse under Ling Yuan's overwhelming pressure, the ethereal blue light dissolving into scattered stars in the void. The outside world grew increasingly clear—countless sword lights, austere formations, and dozens of powerful figures.

Ling Yuan led the expedition in person, the full might of Tianqing Sect displayed in this moment.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, turning to Su Qingyao: "Ready?"

A cold smile curled at Su Qingyao's lips, her hand already resting on her sword hilt: "What do you think?"
